title: Pneumatic Hose Routing & Air Leak Inspections
description: Foundational workplace English module covering pneumatic hose routing & air leak inspections.
learning_objectives: Master professional Present Continuous for Active Faults in automotive engineering
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in pneumatic hose routing & air leak inspections
Demonstrate precision in technical and regulatory documentation

questions.prompt: The assembly line mechanic usually _____ the differential gear casing with a calibrated pneumatic impact driver.

explanations.correct: Singular subject takes 3rd person singular Present Simple with '-s' ('tightens').
